P2_DIRECT_PARENT_NOT_REQUIRED_NON_TEXTUA.rationale: Non-textual composition/group nodes do not require a direct textual parent; preserve membership and ordering.

P3_DIRECT_PARENT_NOT_REQUIRED_ROLE_ALIAS.rationale: Canonical speech and role alias at the same explicit locus do not each require an independent textual parent; preserve both nodes and the crosswalk.

P4_LOCAL_RELATION_SUFFICIENT.rationale: Accepted typed local relations sufficiently constrain textual placement; preserve each relation type.

P5_CONTAINER_MEMBERSHIP_SUFFICIENT.rationale: Accepted composition membership, same-level relation and structural function suffice; do not synthesize nearest-preceding-onset parents.

P6_GLOBAL_LAYER_RELATION_SUFFICIENT.rationale: Frozen global seam judgment and composition, transition and negative constraints sufficiently express structural status.

P7_GENUINELY_UNRESOLVED_AFTER_LAYERED_RE.rationale:
Job 2:11–13은 독립적인 FRIENDS_ARRIVAL /
PARTICIPANT_INTRODUCTION textual unit으로 이미 판정되었고,
둘째 시험 장면 2:1–10의 하위 단위가 아니라는 negative constraint도
확정되어 있다. 또한 1:1–2:13의 OPENING_NARRATIVE_COMPLEX 안에서
composition member로 위치가 충분히 표현된다.
따라서 2:11을 1:1, 2:1, 3:1 또는 다른 textual node의
CHILD_OF로 추가 지정할 필요가 없다.
